summary: This tutorial explains how to use Thunderbird on Ubuntu 12.04, focusing on adding a Thunderbird shortcut to the launcher, organizing emails, tagging messages, and saving them. To add a Thunderbird shortcut, drag its icon to the launcher after typing it in the search field. Messages can be organized by sender, subject, or date using the appropriate column headers. Tags can be used to categorize emails; for example, marking an email as important changes its color. Quick filters can also be applied to view tagged messages. Message threads show related messages in a conversation view, which can be toggled on or off. Emails can be saved to a new folder named "saved mails" for later reference.
